result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming the `buildAndDeployment` aspect no longer stops the export. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed-aspect export, so the fix itself is untested.

The change is in `DataExporter.java` in the `reports` module. The zip block used to read five fixed file names such as `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. It now goes through the five scope aspects in the same order (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other). For each one it gets the name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that names the loose text files. It uses that name both to read the file and as the zip entry name.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written too when a `git-history.txt` exists.
